items.headline: NC State's Todd Goebbel dedicates first win to Dave Doeren
items.description: Todd Goebbel picked up his first win as a head coach with NC State, but his thoughts were with his predecessor as he dedicated it to former coach Dave Doeren.

items.headline: Bailey, Gause lead NC State to 31-10 win over California
items.description: — N.C. State was ready for something positive after a week of negativity following a disappointing loss at Stanford and the firing of coach Dave Doeren.

items.headline: Sources: Philip Rivers in talks about NC State coaching job
items.description: Former NC State QB Philip Rivers has engaged in serious discussions about returning to coach his alma mater, though sources told ESPN that a deal isn't close.
